ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure. Above the center there is a positively charged N; N is respectively connected to R2 and R3, and forms an N=C double-bond-like connection with the carbon below; this carbon is further connected to the carbon on the right/below, and the latter is connected to O; O is further connected to negatively charged B. B is also connected to R1, and connected to two OH groups. There are also curved arrows in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring the arrows. Reasoning: List one by one according to the connections between non-hydrogen atoms/groups: N–R2, N–R3, N=C, C–C, C–O, O–B, B–R1, B–O (left OH), B–O (right OH). Do not count the O–H bonds in the two OH groups, and do not count the curved arrows. Therefore the total number is 9.

method.method_draft: List every non-hydrogen atom/group connection visible in the image: N–R2, N–R3, N=C, C–C, C–O, O–B, B–R1, B–O(left OH), and B–O(right OH). Do not count the O–H bonds in the OH groups and do not count curved arrows. The adjacency list contains 9 bonds.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，中心上方有带正电的 N，N 分别连接 R2 和 R3，并与下方的碳形成 N=C 双键样连接；该碳再连接到右侧/下方的碳，后者连接到 O；O 再连接到带负电的 B。B 还连接 R1，并连接两个 OH 基团。图中还有弯曲箭头，但题目要求忽略箭头。
推理：按非氢原子/基团之间的连接逐一列出：N–R2、N–R3、N=C、C–C、C–O、O–B、B–R1、B–O（左侧 OH）、B–O（右侧 OH）。不计入两个 OH 中的 O–H 键，也不计入弯曲箭头。因此总数为 9。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the transition-state drawing as a chemical graph: N is bonded to R2, R3, and the lower carbon by a drawn double bond; that carbon is bonded to the right-hand carbon chain leading to O; O is bonded to B; B is bonded to R1 and to two O groups labeled HO/OH. planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the convention that a displayed single/double/triple connection between two non-hydrogen atoms or groups counts as one bond occurrence for this question; bonds to H atoms in HO/OH are excluded, but B–O bonds are included.

method.method_draft: Count by fragments: top iminium portion has 3 non-H bonds: R2–N, N–R3, and N=C. The connecting chain/ring portion adds 2 bonds: C–C and C–O. The boron center portion adds 4 bonds: O–B, B–R1, B–O to the lower-left OH, and B–O to the lower-right OH. Sum 3 + 2 + 4 = 9.
